held.busy: Wait: the last change is still being saved.
held.noIssue: Issuing and sending invoices needs the right to issue invoices.
held.noManage: Making drafts needs the right to manage invoices.
held.noRecord: Recording payments needs the right to record payments.
held.noRules: Changing these rules needs the right to manage deposit rules.
held.noTaxManage: Changing tax codes and stamp duty quarters needs the right to manage the tax set-up.
held.noTaxSwitch: The accountant's switches and confirmations need the right to switch tax rules.
held.noTestMode: Going live or back to test mode needs the right to manage e-invoice test mode.
held.noneMissing: Every send has our copy already.

refusal.DATABASE: Someone changed this at the same moment: it was read again, try once more.
refusal.SWITCH_OFF: This waits for the accountant: its switch is off (Finance settings › Tax set-up).
refusal.IN_FORCE: A code in force is never edited: make a new version from a later day.
refusal.OVERLAP: Another version of this code covers some of these days: change its days first.
refusal.NOT_PLANNED: Only a version not yet in force can be deleted: end it or archive it.
refusal.NEXT_VERSION: The new version must start after the current one started, from today or later.
refusal.CONFIRMED: The accountant confirmed this version already.
refusal.ARCHIVED: This version is archived: it changes no more.
refusal.QUARTER_OPEN: The quarter is still running: its payment is recorded after it ends.
refusal.QUARTER_PAID: The quarter is paid: it is not counted again.
refusal.SELF_INVOICE: This supplier invoice cannot take that self-invoice (it has one already, its kind differs, or its supplier is not abroad).
refusal.SELF_INVOICE_ISSUED: The self-invoice is issued: it cannot be cancelled (a correction goes through its own credit note).
refusal.NO_RATE: The supplier invoice is in another currency and no exchange rate of its day is kept: add the rate in Finance settings › Currencies & rates.
refusal.DEBIT_NOTE: This invoice cannot take a debit note: only an issued, not rejected TD01 or TD24 can.
refusal.NOT_IN_FORCE: The shipment is no longer held for this.
refusal.MAY_NOT_RELEASE: Letting this shipment go needs the right to release money holds.
refusal.GO_LIVE: The company cannot go live yet: see what holds it on the card.
refusal.COPY_FILES: Some files of the sends could not be copied: try again later.

new.label: New
new.aria: New: credit note, debit note or deposit invoice
new.depositHint: It follows a deposit's payment: record the payment in Payments.

testMode.banner: E-invoice test mode — nothing goes to SDI

SIMULATED.DELIVERED: Sends are answered here, never by the intermediary: each one is delivered.
SIMULATED.REJECTED: Sends are answered here, never by the intermediary: the first send of each invoice is rejected, so the correction can be practised.
SIMULATED.NOT_DELIVERABLE: Sends are answered here, never by the intermediary: SDI cannot deliver them, so the copy to the customer can be practised.

answer.FAKE: The connection is the FAKE intermediary (local and test only): it answers, and nothing leaves the system.
answer.NONE: No single SDI connection is set up yet: sends wait for one.

problem.NO_CONNECTION: The company has no SDI connection: an admin connects the intermediary first (Admin › Connections & API).
problem.SEVERAL_CONNECTIONS: The company has more than one SDI connection: an admin disables the ones not in use first.
problem.CONNECTION_PAUSED: The SDI connection is paused: an admin switches it on again first.
problem.PROVIDER_NOT_CHOSEN: No SDI intermediary is chosen yet: live sending waits for it, so the company stays in test mode.

live.title: Leave e-invoice test mode?
live.forReal: From now on invoices go to SDI for real and cannot be taken back.
live.noTestSends: No invoice was sent in test mode.
live.testSends_one: {count} invoice was sent in test mode: it never reached SDI and keeps its number. Ask your accountant what to do with it before going live.
live.testSends_other: {count} invoices were sent in test mode: they never reached SDI and keep their numbers. Ask your accountant what to do with them before going live.
live.acknowledge: I understand: from now on the invoices of {company} reach SDI and their customers for real.

run.title: Monthly invoice run
run.stepUp: Issue the run and send its invoices to SDI: type the code from your authenticator app.

pick.explain: Customers whose DDTs of {month} take a deferred invoice (TD24). Each customer picked gets one draft with its checks; nothing is issued until you confirm.
pick.failed: Couldn't read the customers of the month

none.title: No deferred invoice is waiting for {month}
none.body: Every DDT of the month is invoiced, or none of its customers is invoiced monthly.

pick.drafts_one: a draft holds some already (taken in)
pick.inOtherRun: in another preview of this month
pick.issuedRun_one: A run of {month} was issued already: {count} invoice.
pick.issuedRun_other: A run of {month} was issued already: {count} invoices.
pick.after: A draft already made by hand for the month is taken into the run, never deleted.

held.reading: Wait: the customers are being read.
held.tooMany: At most {max} customers in one run.
held.noneReady: No draft of the run passes its checks yet: fix them first.
held.cannot: This run cannot be issued now: read it again.
held.cannotPick: This run cannot change its customers now.
held.cannotDelete: This run cannot be deleted now: something in it is issued.

preview.title: Customers of the run
preview.explain: The preview of {month}: one draft per customer with what it bills and its checks. Fix a held draft from its record, then come back.
preview.none: No invoice made: nothing of this month is left to invoice for this customer.
preview.skipped_one: {count} customer had nothing left to invoice and was left out.
preview.skipped_other: {count} customers had nothing left to invoice and were left out.

run.deleted_one: The preview was deleted: its draft stays a draft.
run.deleted_other: The preview was deleted: its {count} drafts stay drafts.

confirm.explain: You are about to issue the run of {month}.
confirm.numbers_one: {count} invoice gets its number and today’s date.
confirm.numbers_other: {count} invoices get their numbers and today’s date.
confirm.send: Each one is sent to SDI at once (in test mode nothing goes to SDI).
confirm.noSend: They are not sent now: send each one from its record.
confirm.held_one: {count} draft does not pass its checks: it stays a draft outside the run.
confirm.held_other: {count} drafts do not pass their checks: they stay drafts outside the run.
confirm.never: An issued invoice never changes: a correction is a credit or a debit note.
confirm.sendNow: Send each invoice to SDI at once
confirm.stepUp: A fresh authenticator code is asked next.

done.notSent_one: {count} not sent: send it from its record.
done.notSent_other: {count} not sent: send them from their records.
done.held_one: {count} draft stayed back with its checks.
done.held_other: {count} drafts stayed back with their checks.
done.rowNotSent: Not sent: send it from the invoice
done.rowFilesPending: Not sent: its files are still being made

problem.otherRun: Some of these customers are in another preview of this month: issue or change that run first.
problem.state: The run cannot do this now (it changed meanwhile): it was read again.

stamp.title: Stamp duty this quarter
stamp.explain: The stamp duty the issued invoices carry, quarter by quarter: what is due, by when and with which F24 code.
stamp.failed: Couldn't read the stamp duty quarters
stamp.waits: Waits for the accountant: stamp duty is printed on the e-invoice when due, but it is not charged to the customer and the quarters are not counted (Finance settings › Tax set-up). The figures below are what the issued invoices carry.
stamp.deferred: moved to a later due day: a small first half
stamp.payExplain: The day the F24 (code {code}) was paid: after the quarter ended, not in the future. The quarter is then frozen.
stamp.paidSaved: The payment of Q{n} {year} is recorded.

payProblem.day: Pick the day it was paid.
payProblem.beforeEnd: The day is after the quarter ended.
payProblem.future: The day is today or earlier.

held.switchOff: Waits for the accountant: the stamp duty switch is off.
held.running: The quarter is still running: its payment is recorded after it ends.
held.neverCounted: The quarter was never counted: recount it first.

stamp.rule: The due days and the F24 codes wait for the accountant’s confirmation.

check.label: Stamp duty
check.failed: The stamp duty could not be read now ({why}).
check.DUE: Stamp duty decided: {amount} due, charged to the customer as a line.
check.DUE_NO_PRICE: Stamp duty decided: due, charged to the customer as a line.
check.NOT_DUE: Stamp duty decided: not due (VAT is charged, or the amount without VAT is 77.47 EUR or less).
check.SWITCH_OFF: Stamp duty: waits for the accountant — the e-invoice records it when due, the customer is not charged (Finance settings › Tax set-up).
check.NOT_CHARGED_ON_TYPE: Stamp duty decided: not charged on this kind of document (the e-invoice still records it when due).
check.NOT_EURO: Stamp duty: the invoice is not in euro — decided by hand.
check.mismatch: The draft's stamp duty line does not match the rule's decision (its lines changed): decide it again.

debit.title: New debit note
debit.explain: A debit note (TD05) adds to an issued invoice: an extra charge, a price raised, something forgotten. It goes to the same customer, in the same currency.
debit.creditExplain: A credit note takes back from an issued invoice. Pick the invoice: its own credit note dialog opens next (the whole invoice, some lines or an amount).
debit.invoiceHint: An issued TD01 or TD24, not rejected.
debit.creditInvoiceHint: An issued invoice or deposit invoice, not rejected.
debit.pickNone: No issued invoice can take a debit note
debit.creditPickNone: No issued invoice can take a credit note
debit.pickNoneBody: Issue the invoice first; a rejected one is fixed and sent again instead.
debit.infoFailed: The invoice’s debit notes could not be read now ({why}).
debit.waits: Waits for the accountant: the debit note is drafted now, but its issue waits until the accountant switches debit notes on (Finance settings › Tax set-up).
debit.earlier: Debit notes of this invoice so far
debit.causaleHint: Optional: why it is added. The debited invoice is named by itself.
debit.vat: The VAT follows the rules of the debited invoice and its customer; the draft shows it before you issue.
debit.creditNext: The invoice’s credit note dialog opens next.

held.reading: Wait: the invoice is being read.
held.noPrice: A debit note’s prices need the price grain.

refusal.NOT_DEBITABLE: Only a TD01 or a TD24 takes a debit note.
refusal.NOT_ISSUED: The invoice is not issued yet: change the draft instead.
refusal.REJECTED: SDI rejected this invoice: fix and send it again instead.

vatLimit.title: Time limit on lowering the VAT
vatLimit.reading: Checking the time limit on the VAT…
vatLimit.failed: The time limit on the VAT could not be checked now ({why}).
vatLimit.WITHIN: This decrease may still lower the VAT: until {until}, one year after the operation of {operation} (art. 26 c.3 DPR 633/1972).
vatLimit.BEYOND: More than a year since the operation of {operation} (the limit was {until}): this credit note may not lower the VAT, which stays due. Ask your accountant before you issue it.
vatLimit.NO_LIMIT: No time limit for this reason: the credit note lowers the VAT.
vatLimit.ASK: For “other” reasons ask your accountant whether this credit note may lower the VAT.
vatLimit.WAITS: Waits for the accountant: the time limit on lowering the VAT is not checked while its switch is off (Finance settings › Tax set-up).

balance.title: Balance before shipping
balance.explain: Orders whose terms ask the balance before the goods leave: the system holds their shipments until it is paid, and lets them go by itself once it is.
balance.failed: The balance before shipping could not be read now ({why}).
balance.paidHeld: The balance is paid; the hold below was placed by a person and stays until someone lets it go.
balance.heldShipment: Shipment {number} is held until the balance is paid

held.noRelease: Letting a shipment go needs the right to release money holds.

balance.noShipmentYet: No shipment of this order is waiting yet: the first one will be held until the balance is paid.
balance.holdsUnknown: The shipments of this order are held until the balance is paid (the holds themselves need the right to see shipments).
balance.releaseExplain: The balance before shipping of order {order} is not paid. Once let go, the system does not hold this shipment again for that balance.
balance.releaseHint: Kept on the shipment’s hold history (3 to 2000 characters).

releaseProblem.short: Say why, in a few words.

self.title: Self-invoices
self.explain: Self-invoices we must send to SDI for purchases from abroad, by the 15th of the month after the supplier invoice arrived.
self.waits: Waits for the accountant: self-invoices are drafted, but their issue waits until the accountant switches them on (Finance settings › Tax set-up).

kindWhen.TD17: A service bought from a supplier abroad (EU or not).
kindWhen.TD18: Goods bought from a supplier in another EU country.
kindWhen.TD19: Goods already in Italy bought from a supplier abroad.

stage.draft: Its draft waits to be issued

self.draftedSome: {made} made, {refused} refused: open each one for why.

empty.title: No foreign purchases need a self-invoice
empty.body: A supplier invoice from abroad shows here once it is recorded in Payables.

noRight.title: Self-invoices need the right to see invoices
noRight.body: Ask an admin for it; the supplier invoices above stay as they are.

held.noManage: Making or cancelling a self-invoice needs the right to manage invoices.
held.noCost: A self-invoice carries the purchase’s amounts: it needs the cost grain and the right to see payables.
held.notPending: Only a self-invoice still to send takes a draft.
held.cannot: This self-invoice cannot do that now.
held.issued: An issued self-invoice is never cancelled.
held.noneToDraft: None of the rows chosen takes a draft.

create.title: Create a self-invoice
create.explain: Pick the supplier invoice from abroad; its draft in euro follows (the purchase’s lines with the Italian VAT), ready to issue to SDI.
create.reading: Reading the supplier invoices from abroad…
create.failed: Couldn't read the supplier invoices from abroad

none.title: No supplier invoice from abroad needs one
none.body: Every supplier invoice from abroad has its self-invoice.

create.currency: in {currency}: converted at the rate of its day
create.mixed: Its lines mix goods and services: pick the kind.
create.rateHint: 22 % unless the goods or services take a reduced rate.
create.after: The rules (deadline, kind, rate) wait for the accountant’s confirmation.

self.cancelExplain: The self-invoice for the purchase from {supplier} is cancelled; it can be made again later.
self.cancelExplainDraft: The self-invoice for the purchase from {supplier} is cancelled and its draft deleted with it.

cancelProblem.short: Say why, in a few words.

tax.title: Tax set-up
tax.explain: The company's VAT codes as data — rates, reasons without VAT with their law, the days each is in force — and the duties the accountant switches on. Until a switch is on, invoices follow the built-in rules.
tax.switchesFailed: The switches could not be read now ({why}).

taxCodesOn.title: Tax codes on invoices
taxCodesOn.on: Invoices use these tax codes: every line's VAT is a code in force on the issue day, and a line without VAT prints the code's law.
taxCodesOn.off: Waits for the accountant: invoices use the built-in VAT rules; these codes are kept but reach no invoice yet.

stampDutyOn.title: Stamp duty charged to the customer
stampDutyOn.on: Stamp duty is charged to the customer as an invoice line, and each quarter is counted for payment.
stampDutyOn.off: Waits for the accountant: stamp duty is printed on the e-invoice when due, but not charged to the customer, and the quarters are not counted.

declarationsOfIntentOn.title: Declarations of intent
declarationsOfIntentOn.on: Invoices rest on the customers' declarations of intent: lines without VAT (N3.5) name a checked declaration of the year with enough left.
declarationsOfIntentOn.off: Waits for the accountant: declarations are recorded and checked, but no invoice names one yet.

selfInvoicesOn.title: Self-invoices, debit notes and the VAT time limit
selfInvoicesOn.on: Self-invoices (TD17–TD19) and debit notes (TD05) are issued, and a credit note says whether it may still lower the VAT.
selfInvoicesOn.off: Waits for the accountant: self-invoices and debit notes are drafted but not issued, and the time limit on lowering the VAT is not checked.

taxCodesOn.on: Tax codes on invoices: switched on.
taxCodesOn.off: Tax codes on invoices: switched off.

stampDutyOn.on: Stamp duty charged to the customer: switched on.
stampDutyOn.off: Stamp duty charged to the customer: switched off.

selfInvoicesOn.on: Self-invoices, debit notes and the VAT time limit: switched on.
selfInvoicesOn.off: Self-invoices, debit notes and the VAT time limit: switched off.

tax.tickConfirm: Your accountant confirmed these codes: rate or reason, law and account key.
tax.switchOffNote: Invoices already issued stay as they are; new ones follow the built-in rules again.
tax.stepUpNote: A fresh authenticator code is asked next.

stepUp.switch: Change one of the accountant's switches: type the code from your authenticator app.
stepUp.confirm: Record the accountant's confirmation of a tax code: type the code from your authenticator app.

verb.version: New version from a later day…

tax.notSelectable: Nothing to confirm or archive here.

empty.title: No tax codes yet
empty.body: Add the rates and the reasons without VAT the company uses, each with the day it starts.

explain.edit: This version is not in force yet: every value may change.
explain.relabel: Only the label changes: what the code does stays as it is (a new version changes it).
explain.end: The last day the code is in force. Invoices after it need another code.
explain.version: The current version ends the day before the new one starts. A code in force is never edited.
explain.new: A rate, or a reason without VAT (Natura) with the law printed on the invoice, from the day it starts.

form.unverified: A new code or version waits for the accountant’s confirmation.

field.codeHint: Capitals, digits, dot or hyphen: 22, N3.2, N3.5-DI.
field.label: Label
field.labelHint: What it is for, in one line.
field.rateHint: An Italian rate (22, 10, 5, 4) or 0 with its reason.
field.naturaHint: Why no VAT is charged: the code SDI reads.
field.naturaRate: Only a rate of 0 takes a reason.
field.legalRefHint: For example: Art. 8 c.1 lett. a) DPR 633/1972.
field.accountHint: Optional: the accountant's account for this code.
field.validToHint: Optional: empty while it has no end.

problem.country: Two capitals: IT for Italian VAT.
problem.code: 1 to 20 capitals, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen.
problem.label: Say what the code is for, in one line.
problem.ratePct: An Italian rate (22, 10, 5, 4) or 0 with its reason.
problem.natura: A rate of 0 takes its reason; a rate above 0 takes none.
problem.legalRef: A reason without VAT cites its law, in one line.
problem.accountCodeKey: Letters, digits, dot, colon, slash or hyphen, up to 60.
problem.validTo: The last day is on or after the first.
problem.versionFrom: The new version starts after the current one started, from tomorrow on.

verbTitle.confirm_other: Record the accountant's confirmation of {count} codes?

verbExplain.archive: An archived version reaches no invoice and changes no more; issued invoices keep it.
verbExplain.delete: A version not in force yet is deleted for good.
verbExplain.confirm: The version becomes confirmed with who and when; it is said once and stays.

saved.new: Code {code} added: it waits for the accountant’s confirmation.
saved.version: A new version of {code} is made.
saved.end: Code {code} ends on the day set.

sdi.title: E-invoice test mode
sdi.explain: Before going live, sends are answered without reaching SDI, so the office can practise issuing, rejections and corrections. The banner shows on every invoice page while it is on.
sdi.liveReal: SDI, through the intermediary: invoices reach their customers for real.
sdi.liveFake: The FAKE intermediary (local and test only): nothing leaves the system.
sdi.simulateHint: What SDI's simulated answer says to each send.
sdi.simulateFake: With the FAKE intermediary the fake answers; the simulated answer applies to a live or sandbox connection.

outcome.REJECTED: Rejected on the first send (practise the correction)
outcome.NOT_DELIVERABLE: Not deliverable (practise the copy to the customer)

simulated.DELIVERED: Sends are now answered as delivered.
simulated.REJECTED: The first send of each invoice is now answered as rejected.
simulated.NOT_DELIVERABLE: Sends are now answered as not deliverable.

sdi.backExplain: From now on sends are answered without reaching SDI. Invoices sent while live stay as they are.
sdi.stepUpNote: A fresh authenticator code is asked next.
sdi.stepUp: Change how the company sends its e-invoices: type the code from your authenticator app.
sdi.wentLive: The company is live: invoices now go to SDI for real.
sdi.backInTest: The company is back in test mode: nothing goes to SDI.

swap.title: Swap intermediary
swap.explain: We keep our own copy of every XML we send and of every receipt, so the company can change intermediary without losing anything.
swap.ready_one: Every send has our complete copy ({count}): the intermediary can be changed.
swap.ready_other: Every send has our complete copy ({count}): the intermediary can be changed.
swap.missing_one: {count} send lacks our complete copy: make the copies first.
swap.missing_other: {count} sends lack our complete copy: make the copies first.
swap.open_one: {count} send still waits for SDI's answer at the intermediary.
swap.open_other: {count} sends still wait for SDI's answer at the intermediary.
swap.made: {made} copies made, {completed} completed, {remaining} still to make.
swap.ourRecord: A receipt here is our record of SDI's notification as the intermediary handed it, not SDI's signed receipt.

skip.fromEndOfMonth: Count the days from the end of the month (“30 days e.o.m.”)
skip.monthsLabel: Months no instalment falls due in
skip.problem: At most 11 months: one month at least stays to pay in.
skip.none: No convention: the days count from the event, every month may hold a due day.
skip.rule: A due day in a skipped month moves to the same day of the next month not skipped (the end of the month when it was one). Your accountant confirms the convention agreed with the customer.

rule.title: Refund on cancellation
rule.explain: What is kept or paid back of a deposit when an order is cancelled, and which document follows. Without a rule everything is paid back.
rule.accountant: The rules wait for the accountant’s word: the document for a kept caparra and for the extra half paid back.

document.CREDIT_NOTE: A credit note of the deposit invoice

REFUND_ALL.CREDIT_NOTE: All paid back; a credit note of the deposit invoice follows.
REFUND_ALL.NONE: All paid back; no document follows.

KEEP_PERCENT.CREDIT_NOTE: {pct} % kept, the rest paid back; a credit note of what is paid back follows.
KEEP_PERCENT.NONE: {pct} % kept, the rest paid back; no document follows.

REFUND_DOUBLE.CREDIT_NOTE: Twice the deposit paid back; a credit note of the deposit invoice follows, the extra half paid in Payments.
REFUND_DOUBLE.NONE: Twice the deposit paid back; no document follows.

empty.title: No rule yet: everything is paid back
empty.body: Add a rule for each deposit the company keeps or pays back differently.

held.archived: An archived rule changes no more.

field.fixed: Fixed once the rule exists: archive it and add another.
field.noteHint: Optional: the clause on the quote, for example.

problem.keepPct: Above 0 and up to 100 percent, at most 4 decimals.
problem.refundRule: Twice back only for a caparra, when we cancel (c.c. artt. 1385, 1386).
problem.documentKind: All of it is kept: nothing is paid back, so no document follows.
problem.note: A note of 1 to 500 characters, or none.
problem.oneActive: The company has an active rule for this deposit, side and kind of order already: change that one, or archive it first.

rule.archiveExplain: An archived rule decides no cancellation; without another active rule everything is paid back.
